Farming originated in the near East by the early men.  [click]

Early people were wanderers and gatherers of fruits, nuts and roots:
The early man was a hunter of animals and gathered of plants,
The early woman raised new crops from the seeds and fruits eaten by man and woman,
The woman tried to rear captured young animals,
In this way the early people began to practice farming.  [click]
